title: Anthropic Pledges 20% of Shares to New Public Benefit Fund
summary:
The company is creating a new entity to facilitate grants to nonprofits and cash payments to individuals as a way to counter the disruption caused by automation. This initiative, combined with equity pledges from co-founders and staff, allocates roughly 20% of the firm's total shares to the public good. The new fund specifically starts with a 5% stake and can grow by 2% for every 50% increase in valuation above a set baseline, depending on board approval.

Equity held by the fund is barred from being used for political donations or lobbying. The move follows separate pledges by Anthropic co-founders to donate 80% of their equity, while approximately half of the company's employees have contributed shares through a matching program. The AI firm will provide further details on the fund's legal structure and progress in an upcoming report.

selectedTweets.bestBit: roughly 20% of Anthropic’s shares are committed to the public good
selectedTweets.text:
We’re committing a portion of Anthropic’s shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new wholly owned entity dedicated entirely to the public benefit.

It will start off with 5% of our shares. For every 50% increase in the company’s value over a set baseline, we can contribute up to an extra 2%, subject to our board’s discretion.

In total, this means that roughly 20% of Anthropic’s shares are committed to the public good. Our co-founders have already pledged to donate 80% of their equity, and around half our employees are donating a portion of their equity as part of a donation matching program we’ve run since our founding.

In the post below, we share more details about our new fund.

https://t.co/XzDntVH0vH

The most significant line for me is "direct distributions to specific populations." It sounds to me like they are planning their own form of self-directed global UBI. About half of Anth employees are also donating shares into this fund. They foresee a transformative future. https://t.co/uijSXnsqu6
